Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and for being open about your capacity situation.

We are ready to give you the firm commitment you asked for: a binding 23,400 pieces per year for 24 months, and we accept a longer lead time of 56 days so you can plan production.

Our orders for the 24 mm mechanical seal were at EUR 28.94 in 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for this seal is EUR 24.31 per piece (cost:340010).

We therefore propose to keep EUR 29.89 per piece, the price we have paid since January 2024.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. While your historical price references are noted, they do not align with current operational costs. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We accept the proposed volume of 23,400 pieces, the 24-month contract, and the 56-day lead time. Under these updated terms, we can revise our offer to a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your answer. We move towards you: we extend the commitment to 36 months, 70,200 pieces in total, and propose EUR 30.40 per piece.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your proposal to extend the contract duration to 36 months. In exchange for this longer commitment, we can revise our price to EUR 31.20 per unit. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

For clarity, our offer comprises a price of €31.20 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days. We await your confirmation of these updated terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
